links.description: Ordered list of links shown on the series. Use the DID form (at://did:...), not a handle.

banner.description: The banner image of the series. 3:1 aspect ratio. (e.g. 3000x1000 pixels)

format.description: The reading format of the series. 'vertical' chapters are made of slices; 'page' chapters are made of pages. 'strip' series have no chapters; their strips point to the series directly. AppViews may define their own formats.

labels.description: Self-labels and content warnings for this series. Use the standard AT Protocol values ('porn', 'sexual', 'nudity', 'graphic-media') where they apply. AppViews may define additional values (e.g. 'profanity', 'violence'); AppViews that don't recognize a value ignore it.

poster.description: The open graph share image of the series. 1.91:1 aspect ratio. (e.g. 1200x630 pixels) JPEG or PNG only, because many link preview crawlers don't support newer formats.

status.description: Publication status of the series. AppViews may define their own statuses.

chapters.description: Ordered list of chapters in this series. Not used by the 'strip' format. Use the DID form (at://did:...), not a handle.

createdAt.description: The date and time the series was created.

categories.description: Categories for this series, most relevant first.

description.description: Localized short description of the series.

nativeLanguage.description: BCP-47 language tag of the language the series was created in. AppViews should fall back to it when a reader's language isn't available.

readingDirection.description: Horizontal reading direction of panels and pages. 'rtl' for right-to-left comics such as manga.

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag for this description.

localizedDescription.description: Same as work.sequential.defs#localizedDescription, but limited to a short blurb.
